_comment: THE DOUBT ENGINE config (canon, committed). Shape taxonomy v0 = marker heuristics over the mandatory 'maine-socha-X-phir-Y' doubt structure (FORGE_SPEC §3 makes doubts machine-parseable by construction). Shapes are MACHINE-SIDE: they seed probe design and are never shown pre-Pehle-Guess. Lexicon anchors are verbatim extraction only — Claude never invents his metaphors; breaking-points are the captain's to declare.
_gates_opened_2026_08_18: min_capsules 4 → 1, min_doubts 60 → 1: clusters are mined over whatever exists and the gate_line prints n. tape_room.min_age_days 14 is a WINDOW (a rematch too soon is not a rematch — spaced repetition), allowed guessed. lexicon.min_count 2 is the DEFINITION of recurrence (derived: once is not recurring). OPENED 18 Aug 2026 — ORGANISM_OVERHAUL §5.4 (his 1 Aug 'why are we setting numerical limits … everything fully opened' + 13 Aug 'I do not have 30 days to wait for data' + 18 Aug 'full permission'): a guessed number may be a GUARD or a WINDOW, never a BUDGET or a CALENDAR GATE. A speak-gate at 1 is arithmetic (you cannot compute on an empty set), not a wall — the organ speaks on what he has and prints n. Verify: node scripts/limits.mjs (0 guessed gates).
_lexicon_comment: max_anchors + min_content_words were live knobs with no key here until 11 Aug 2026 — both carried their value as a literal in doubtminer.mjs, so neither could be audited or retuned from config. Both are written at their INCUMBENT values (nothing moves today): max_anchors 25 is the constant that produced every lexicon.json to date, min_content_words 1 is audit #4's MEASURED value. max_anchors is the one that was cutting his voice in silence — see doubtminer.mjs selectAnchors.
_lexicon_cap_opened_2026_08_18: max_anchors 25 → 0 (= NO CAP; selectAnchors treats ≤0 as none): every mined anchor ships — his voice is not a budget. Measured the morning it opened: 25 of 45 shipped, 20 dropped by the cap. The guards that remain are #4's connective filter and min_count; the cost (anchor bytes at the head of every LLM call) is cached under the sitting brain (§6.2) and printed by lexicon.json anchor_line either way.
